newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds off to flying start following abroad.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds off to flying start following abroad.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened comfortably higher on Friday bolstered by foreign bourse advances and the strong dollar with dealers foreseeing further gains but warning of thin trading.
"We're following foreign markets upwards due to the strong dollar but trading is thin and I cannot see any major buying interest," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened 0.20 point up from Thursday's close at 108.90. The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 94 basis points. The crown opened at a stable 3.8361 per mark.--Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
